title: The 5 Elements Massage in Singapore
description: Combines manual drainage and connective tissue massage with Anesi Cellular 3 to de-puff, lift, and stop glycation.

blocks.html: A TCM massage series. You always choose the element you need.
A TCM massage series built on five elements — Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water — each mapping to a distinct physical and emotional state, with its own treatment plan.
You select your element based on how you’re feeling today — your therapist then delivers a full-body massage with the corresponding oil blend and enhancement.

– Muscle tension and physical stiffness

– Poor circulation or persistent coldness

– Digestive discomfort and bloating

– Low energy and fatigue

– Stress, anxiety, or difficulty sleeping

“Your body isn’t the same visit to visit. The 5 Elements framework is how you treat it on its own terms —

you decide, your therapist delivers.”

“Your body isn’t the same visit to visit.

The 5 Elements framework is how you treat it on its own terms — you decide, your therapist delivers.”

The 5 Elements Massage pairs skilled full-body bodywork with an element-specific oil blend and a targeted enhancement. You choose your element at booking or on arrival — based on how you’re feeling today — and your therapist delivers the corresponding treatment from there.
The massage oil for your chosen element is applied throughout — each blend formulated to support the physical and emotional state that element addresses.
Choose your massage style — Sports, Tuina, Deep Tissue, or Swedish — each applied with technique and pressure suited to your element.
A targeted add-on closes the session — Muscle Blade (Wood), Infra Ray Moxibustion (Fire), Herbal Volcanic Warming Mask (Earth), Cupping (Metal), or Back Scrub (Water).
Each session follows your choice. Come in knowing your element, or take a moment on arrival to decide — the element cards below are there to help.

Each element governs a set of organs, a tissue type, and a recognisable pattern of physical and emotional symptoms. Select the one that corresponds to how you’re arriving today — your therapist will confirm the match at the start of your session.

Your therapist confirms the element selection at the start of each session. If you’re unsure which element fits, share how you’re feeling and they will guide you.

In Traditional Chinese Medicine, the body and mind are never treated separately. Each of the five elements — Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water — governs not just a set of organs, but a mood, a tension pattern, a way of moving through the world. When one element is out of balance, you feel it: in your muscles, your sleep, your energy, your emotional steadiness.

The 5 Elements Massage honours that connection. Your chosen element shapes every part of the session — the oil blend selected for your state, the massage style applied to your body, the enhancement that closes the treatment. Nothing is generic. Every choice is made for where you are today.

blocks.text: Do I choose my own element, or does the therapist choose for me?
blocks.html: Do I choose my own element, or does the therapist choose for me?
You choose. If you’re unsure which element fits how you’re feeling today, your therapist is happy to talk it through with you — but the decision is always yours.

blocks.text: What if my symptoms cross more than one element?
blocks.html: What if my symptoms cross more than one element?

If two elements feel equally relevant, choose the one that describes your most pressing concern today. There’s no wrong answer — and no fixed element. The series gives you the freedom to explore a different element on your next visit.

blocks.text: How is this different from a standard massage?
blocks.html: How is this different from a standard massage?
Each massage in the 5 Elements series combines a customised oil blend and a matched enhancement, thoughtfully organised to treat not just how your body feels, but how you feel.

blocks.text: How you feel today deserves a treatment made for today.
blocks.html: How you feel today deserves a treatment made for today.

Your chosen element brings together a customised oil blend, a matched enhancement, and skilled full-body bodywork. The result is a treatment that honours both your body and your state of mind.
